dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged light-intensity perimeters forming multiple closed 'O' and semi-closed 'C' loops across the mid-lateral field; prominent structures exhibit a sharp transition from the dark primary coat to a high-intensity perimeter with a darker central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, asymmetrical light-grey pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the cranio-dorsal and ventral-lateral regions; these clusters lack internal gradients and appear as isolated high-contrast spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest axis oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge.
